import bpy, math, os
print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)

# --- clean scene ---
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
# remove all materials/meshes/curves leftover
for coll in [bpy.data.meshes, bpy.data.curves, bpy.data.materials]:
    for x in list(coll):
        try: coll.remove(x)
        except Exception: pass

def active_obj():
    return bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active

def deselect_all():
    try: bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    except Exception: pass

def ensure_object_mode():
    if bpy.context.mode != 'OBJECT':
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')

def make_mat(name, color, roughness=0.8, metallic=0.0, emission=None, emission_strength=0.0, alpha=None):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (color[0], color[1], color[2], 1.0)
    if "Roughness" in bsdf.inputs: bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    if "Metallic" in bsdf.inputs: bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    if emission is not None and "Emission Color" in bsdf.inputs:
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (emission[0], emission[1], emission[2], 1.0)
    if "Emission Strength" in bsdf.inputs:
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emission_strength
    if alpha is not None:
        try: bsdf.inputs["Alpha"].default_value = alpha
        except Exception: pass
        m.blend_method = 'BLEND'
    return m

def assign(obj, m):
    if obj.data.materials: obj.data.materials.clear()
    obj.data.materials.append(m)

def shade_smooth(obj):
    ensure_object_mode(); deselect_all()
    obj.select_set(True); bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
    try: bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
    except Exception: pass
    deselect_all()

# materials
M = {}
M['octo']   = make_mat("OctoSkin", (0.93, 0.32, 0.28), roughness=0.55)
M['octo_d'] = make_mat("OctoDark", (0.78, 0.20, 0.22), roughness=0.6)
M['sucker'] = make_mat("Sucker", (1.0, 0.75, 0.72), roughness=0.7)
M['white']  = make_mat("White", (0.96, 0.95, 0.92), roughness=0.5)
M['black']  = make_mat("Black", (0.05, 0.05, 0.06), roughness=0.4)
M['hat']    = make_mat("HatWhite", (0.98, 0.98, 0.97), roughness=0.6)
M['scarf']  = make_mat("ScarfBlue", (0.15, 0.30, 0.75), roughness=0.6)
M['wood']   = make_mat("Wood", (0.55, 0.34, 0.18), roughness=0.8)
M['wood_d'] = make_mat("WoodDark", (0.36, 0.22, 0.12), roughness=0.85)
M['red']    = make_mat("Red", (0.80, 0.10, 0.10), roughness=0.6)
M['cream']  = make_mat("Cream", (0.98, 0.93, 0.80), roughness=0.7)
M['roof']   = make_mat("RoofRed", (0.72, 0.08, 0.08), roughness=0.65)
M['noren']  = make_mat("NorenBlue", (0.12, 0.25, 0.55), roughness=0.75)
M['broth']  = make_mat("Broth", (0.85, 0.45, 0.12), roughness=0.35)
M['noodle'] = make_mat("Noodle", (0.95, 0.78, 0.30), roughness=0.55)
M['egg']    = make_mat("Egg", (0.99, 0.97, 0.90), roughness=0.5)
M['yolk']   = make_mat("Yolk", (0.98, 0.62, 0.10), roughness=0.4)
M['naru']   = make_mat("Naruto", (1.0, 0.45, 0.55), roughness=0.5)
M['bowl']   = make_mat("BowlBlue", (0.15, 0.25, 0.60), roughness=0.35)
M['bowl2']  = make_mat("BowlRed", (0.75, 0.15, 0.12), roughness=0.35)
M['steel']  = make_mat("Steel", (0.55, 0.57, 0.60), roughness=0.3, metallic=0.8)
M['pot']    = make_mat("Pot", (0.20, 0.20, 0.22), roughness=0.45, metallic=0.6)
M['board']  = make_mat("Board", (0.16, 0.13, 0.10), roughness=0.9)
M['paper']  = make_mat("Paper", (0.99, 0.94, 0.80), roughness=0.8)
M['leaf']   = make_mat("Leaf", (0.15, 0.45, 0.15), roughness=0.6)
M['ground'] = make_mat("Ground", (0.42, 0.36, 0.30), roughness=0.95)
M['lantern']= make_mat("Lantern", (1.0, 0.55, 0.15), roughness=0.5, emission=(1.0,0.45,0.10), emission_strength=1.2)
M['steam']  = make_mat("Steam", (0.95, 0.95, 0.97), roughness=1.0, alpha=0.22)
M['pink']   = make_mat("Blush", (1.0, 0.45, 0.50), roughness=0.7)

def prim_cube(name, loc, size=None, scale=None, rot=None, m=None, smooth=False):
    deselect_all()
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=2 if scale else (size if size else 2), location=loc)
    o = active_obj(); o.name = name
    if scale: o.scale = scale
    if rot: o.rotation_euler = rot
    if m: assign(o, m)
    if smooth: shade_smooth(o)
    return o

def prim_sphere(name, loc, rad, m=None, seg=24, ring=16, scale=None):
    deselect_all()
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=rad, segments=seg, ring_count=ring, location=loc)
    o = active_obj(); o.name = name
    if scale: o.scale = scale
    if m: assign(o, m)
    shade_smooth(o)
    return o

def prim_cyl(name, loc, rad, depth, m=None, verts=24, rot=None, scale=None):
    deselect_all()
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=rad, depth=depth, vertices=verts, location=loc)
    o = active_obj(); o.name = name
    if rot: o.rotation_euler = rot
    if scale: o.scale = scale
    if m: assign(o, m)
    shade_smooth(o)
    return o

def prim_cone(name, loc, r1, r2, depth, m=None, verts=24, rot=None):
    deselect_all()
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth, vertices=verts, location=loc)
    o = active_obj(); o.name = name
    if rot: o.rotation_euler = rot
    if m: assign(o, m)
    shade_smooth(o)
    return o

def prim_plane(name, loc, size=2, m=None, rot=None):
    deselect_all()
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=size, location=loc)
    o = active_obj(); o.name = name
    if rot: o.rotation_euler = rot
    if m: assign(o, m)
    return o

def prim_torus(name, loc, major, minor, m=None, rot=None):
    deselect_all()
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(location=loc, major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor)
    o = active_obj(); o.name = name
    if rot: o.rotation_euler = rot
    if m: assign(o, m)
    shade_smooth(o)
    return o

def curve_tube(name, pts, radius, m, cap=True):
    ensure_object_mode(); deselect_all()
    bpy.ops.curve.primitive_bezier_curve_add(location=pts[0])
    co = active_obj(); co.name = name
    spl = co.data.splines[0]
    n = len(pts)
    if n > 2: spl.bezier_points.add(n - 2)
    for i, p in enumerate(pts):
        bp = spl.bezier_points[i]
        bp.co = (p[0]-pts[0][0], p[1]-pts[0][1], p[2]-pts[0][2])
        bp.handle_left_type = 'AUTO'; bp.handle_right_type = 'AUTO'
    co.data.bevel_depth = radius
    co.data.bevel_resolution = 2
    try: co.data.use_fill_caps = cap
    except Exception: pass
    # convert to mesh
    deselect_all(); co.select_set(True); bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = co
    bpy.ops.object.convert(target='MESH')
    mo = active_obj(); mo.name = name
    assign(mo, m); shade_smooth(mo)
    return mo

# ================= GROUND =================
g = prim_plane("Ground", (0, 0, 0), size=30, m=M['ground'])
stall_mat = prim_plane("StallFloor", (0, 0.1, 0.005), size=1, m=M['wood_d'])
stall_mat.scale = (5.4, 4.6, 1)

# ================= BOOTH =================
# counter body + top
prim_cube("CounterBody", (0, 0.6, 0.55), scale=(1.7, 0.4, 0.55), m=M['wood'])
prim_cube("CounterTop", (0, 0.6, 1.13), scale=(1.85, 0.5, 0.05), m=M['wood_d'])
# front red banner + white stripes
prim_cube("Banner", (0, 1.005, 0.55), scale=(1.7, 0.02, 0.4), m=M['red'])
for i, x in enumerate([-1.1, -0.35, 0.4, 1.1]):
    prim_cube(f"BannerStripe{i}", (x, 1.02, 0.55), scale=(0.18, 0.015, 0.4), m=M['cream'])
# posts
for x in (-1.7, 1.7):
    for y in (1.0, -1.0):
        prim_cyl(f"Post{x}{y}", (x, y, 1.3), 0.07, 2.6, m=M['wood_d'], verts=12)
# back wall (warm wood slats look via single wall + beams)
prim_cube("BackWall", (0, -1.05, 1.3), scale=(1.75, 0.05, 1.3), m=M['wood'])
prim_cube("BackBeam", (0, -0.98, 2.0), scale=(1.8, 0.06, 0.08), m=M['wood_d'])
# roof: big slanted slab + striped awning
prim_cube("RoofSlab", (0, 0.0, 3.0), scale=(2.2, 1.9, 0.08), rot=(math.radians(-12), 0, 0), m=M['wood_d'])
for i in range(9):
    x = -1.9 + i * 0.475
    mm = M['roof'] if i % 2 == 0 else M['cream']
    prim_cube(f"Awning{i}", (x, 0.95, 2.62), scale=(0.24, 0.85, 0.045), rot=(math.radians(-28), 0, 0), m=mm)
# front header board + RAMEN text
prim_cube("HeaderBoard", (0, 1.15, 2.35), scale=(1.7, 0.06, 0.32), m=M['wood_d'])
deselect_all()
bpy.ops.object.text_add(location=(-1.05, 1.22, 2.2))
to = active_obj(); to.name = "SignText"
to.data.body = "RAMEN"
to.rotation_euler = (math.radians(90), 0, 0)
to.scale = (0.55, 0.55, 0.55)
try: to.data.extrude = 0.04
except Exception: pass
ensure_object_mode(); deselect_all(); to.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = to
bpy.ops.object.convert(target='MESH')
to = active_obj(); assign(to, M['cream'])
# small star accents
for x in (-1.45, 1.45):
    s = prim_sphere(f"Star{x}", (x, 1.2, 2.35), 0.09, m=M['lantern'], seg=8, ring=6)
    s.scale = (1, 0.4, 1)
# noren curtains (3 panels) under header
for i, x in enumerate([-0.62, 0.0, 0.62]):
    p = prim_plane(f"Noren{i}", (x, 1.02, 1.85), size=1, m=M['noren'])
    p.scale = (0.58, 1.0, 0.55)
    p.rotation_euler = (0, 0, 0)
# white circle emblem on middle curtain
prim_cyl("NorenEmblem", (0, 1.03, 1.85), 0.14, 0.02, m=M['paper'], rot=(math.radians(90), 0, 0))
# menu board on back wall + chalk lines
prim_cube("MenuBoard", (-1.05, -0.97, 1.55), scale=(0.45, 0.03, 0.5), m=M['board'])
for i in range(4):
    prim_cube(f"MenuLine{i}", (-1.05, -0.94, 1.72 - i*0.16), scale=(0.33, 0.012, 0.035), m=M['paper'])
prim_cube("MenuBoard2", (1.1, -0.97, 1.6), scale=(0.4, 0.03, 0.42), m=M['board'])
for i in range(3):
    prim_cube(f"Menu2Line{i}", (1.1, -0.94, 1.72 - i*0.16), scale=(0.28, 0.012, 0.035), m=M['paper'])
# paper lanterns hanging at front
for i, x in enumerate([-1.25, 1.25]):
    prim_sphere(f"Lantern{i}", (x, 1.0, 2.05), 0.17, m=M['lantern'], seg=20, ring=14)
    prim_cyl(f"LanternCap{i}a", (x, 1.0, 2.22), 0.06, 0.05, m=M['black'], verts=12)
    prim_cyl(f"LanternCap{i}b", (x, 1.0, 1.88), 0.06, 0.05, m=M['black'], verts=12)
    prim_cyl(f"LanternCord{i}", (x, 1.0, 2.35), 0.012, 0.25, m=M['black'], verts=8)
# side shelf with bowls stack + crates
prim_cube("SideShelf", (2.3, -0.2, 0.5), scale=(0.4, 0.7, 0.5), m=M['wood'])
for i in range(3):
    prim_cone(f"StackBowl{i}", (2.3, -0.2, 1.08 + i*0.14), 0.16, 0.24, 0.14, m=M['bowl'] if i%2==0 else M['bowl2'])
prim_cube("Crate", (-2.3, 0.2, 0.3), scale=(0.35, 0.35, 0.3), m=M['wood'])
prim_sphere("CrateOnion1", (-2.3, 0.2, 0.68), 0.09, m=M['leaf'], seg=12, ring=8)
prim_sphere("CrateOnion2", (-2.15, 0.3, 0.66), 0.08, m=M['leaf'], seg=12, ring=8)

# ================= RAMEN BOWLS =================
def ramen_bowl(name, loc, bowl_mat):
    x, y, z = loc
    prim_cone(name+"Bowl", (x, y, z+0.11), 0.17, 0.30, 0.22, m=bowl_mat, verts=28)
    prim_cyl(name+"Foot", (x, y, z+0.015), 0.12, 0.04, m=bowl_mat, verts=20)

    prim_cyl(name+"Naru", (x-0.12, y-0.06, z+0.26), 0.045, 0.025, m=M['white'], verts=16)
    prim_cyl(name+"NaruC", (x-0.12, y-0.06, z+0.27), 0.02, 0.028, m=M['naru'], verts=12)
    prim_cyl(name+"Leaf", (x+0.02, y-0.12, z+0.26), 0.05, 0.012, m=M['leaf'], verts=12)
    # resting chopsticks
